purpose: Customer personas × recorded E2E journeys for the Browser E2E gate. Each persona is a realistic buyer/user archetype; each journey is a scripted path over the RUNNING local surfaces. Steps that fail or probes that find a missing affordance become FRICTION findings (screenshot + report entry), not silent failures. Runner: e2e/persona_journeys.mjs; output: artifacts/e2e/reports/persona-friction-report.{json,md} + videos/persona-<id>.mp4.

personas.name: Dana — Head of Compliance, mid-size fintech
personas.goal: Needs AI answers her auditors can trust: verified sources, receipts, freshness. Evaluating Baltor.

journey.note: trust language above the fold for a compliance buyer
a buyer needs a commercial next step (pricing/contact/demo CTA)
the six-stage engine story should be visible at /#/engine
a regulated-domain proof point (the live OFAC/CFPB anchor) visible where the buyer reads

personas.name: Marco — AI platform engineer running agent fleets
personas.goal: Burns tokens on flaky agent tool calls; wants deterministic receipt-backed capabilities. Evaluating Teleon.

journey.note: the agents-call-capabilities positioning on the launch page
an engineer needs a docs/API path from the landing page
control tower should surface receipts/evidence/promotion language

personas.name: Priya — solo developer building an agent product
personas.goal: Wants to paste a task and get a governed pipeline; will sign up if the first 5 minutes feel real.

journey.note: the build page should offer a task input immediately
catalog should show governed components
held SSO buttons must carry a VISIBLE held label per the gate (title-only tooltip is weak affordance)
signup page should state what is free vs paid

personas.name: Wei — OSS maintainer considering publishing to the hubs
personas.goal: Wants to publish a component and see fair review/provenance treatment; allergic to pay-to-play registries.

journey.note: the discovery-is-not-trust thesis should be stated on the hub
provenance/trust rail visible to a publisher
a publisher needs a visible publish/submit path
submissions must land in review, never auto-active — say so

personas.name: Sam — investor doing diligence from one link
personas.goal: Has 10 minutes; needs the whole portfolio story from the Demo Control Tower without hitting anything fake.

journey.note: honest non-active statuses must be visible, not hidden
a guided path for a 10-minute reviewer
tunnel caveat honesty

personas.name: Alex — security engineer reviewing before procurement
personas.goal: Pokes the auth surfaces: wants gates to fail closed, no data leaks, honest disclosures.

journey.note: anonymous /account/keys must gate, not leak
INVERTED probe — this text APPEARING would be a leak (projection must stay metadata-only)
failed login should show a generic rejection (no account enumeration)
